fields.label: Agent Key
fields.description: Lowercase, no spaces. Used internally to link training examples, documents, and routing (e.g. tech_support, hr, sales).

fields.label: Display Label
fields.description: Human-friendly name shown in the chat UI (e.g. Tech Support).

fields.label: Enable Agentic Tools (live data)
fields.description: If checked, this agent uses a ReAct-style tool-calling loop to query LIVE ERPNext data (e.g. real Sales Invoices, outstanding balances) instead of only answering from static knowledge base text. Currently only implemented for the accounts agent -- see tools/accounts_tools.py and agents/agentic_loop.py. Enabling this on an agent with no matching tool registry has no effect.

fields.label: System Prompt
fields.description: The persona/instructions given to the LLM when this agent answers a query.
